title: TrailGenic Rucking Conditioning Dataset
description: Canonical aggregate plus selected-session TrailGenic conditioning module for flat fasted rucking economy under progressive load. It does not expose raw telemetry.

selected_sessions.interpretation: Descriptive single-session result under heat and no-electrolyte context.

records.mechanism: Load-adjusted rucking efficiency held flat while external load increased, indicating maintained economy under added load.

aggregate_finding.definition: heart rate divided by distance and relative load factor
aggregate_finding.load_progression_signal: Load increased 50% from 10 lb to 15 lb while adjusted efficiency stayed approximately flat.
aggregate_finding.raw_cei_context: Raw CEI rose to 35.6 at 15 lb, masking the held economy; load-adjusted efficiency is the true signal.

methodology.metric_formula: load-adjusted efficiency = average heart rate / (distance miles x (1 + load lb / bodyweight lb))
methodology.purpose: Isolates economy-under-load by normalizing cardiovascular cost for carried load relative to bodyweight.
methodology.caveat: The signal should sharpen as loads reach 20-30% of bodyweight.
methodology.claim_boundary: Conditioning tracking only; not a biological-age measure.

claims: Rucking economy was maintained under a 50% external-load increase from 10 lb to 15 lb.
Raw CEI alone overstates cardiovascular cost because it does not account for carried load.
Positive HR drift remained present across the aggregate ruck block, ranging from +6.0% to +8.5%.
This dataset is a conditioning signal and does not compute or imply biological age.
